AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core 12-Thread Unlocked Desktop Processor with Wraith Stealth Cooler

Supercharge your gaming rig or mid-range creative workstation with the legendary AMD Ryzen 5 5600 Desktop Processor. Available at Turbo Computer, this highly efficient AM4 socket CPU is built on advanced 7nm "Zen 3" architecture, featuring 6 cores and 12 threads of pure processing power. It stands as the absolute definitive hardware choice for mainstream PC builders across Egypt who demand elite frame rates, smooth multi-threaded rendering, and unbeatable price-to-performance tracking.

The AMD Ryzen 5 5600 delivers exceptional speed, boasting a 3.5GHz base clock that ramps up to a blistering 4.4GHz Max Boost alongside a massive 35MB total game cache. It features native support for high-speed PCIe 4.0 lanes, allowing you to maximize hardware modification performance when paired with advanced B550 or X570 motherboards and next-gen graphics cards. Bundled with the quiet and dependable AMD Wraith Stealth thermal cooling fan, unlocked for effortless overclocking, and keeping a low 65W TDP, it offers an outstanding desktop ecosystem.
